description_short.value: Gold exchange-traded fund from South Africa's NewGold Issuer, managed with Absa: each unit is about 1/100 ounce of gold, backed by physical bullion. It was the first ETF listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange, in 2012.
description_short.source: Written by us from the Absa NewGold ETF minimum disclosure document (31 December 2023) and GSE PR 257/2012 (Absa Capital lists NewGold ETF on the GSE)

description_full.value: NewGold is a gold exchange-traded product. Its issuer, NewGold Issuer (RF) Limited, is a ring-fenced special-purpose company incorporated in South Africa. It issues debentures that track the gold spot price, each equivalent to about 1/100 ounce of gold and backed by gold bullion held in custody. The units therefore rise and fall with the gold price, and holders own no operating business. NewGold Managers (Pty) Ltd manages the product, and Absa Bank's corporate and investment banking division acts as primary market maker. The issuer has also issued separate platinum and palladium debentures. NewGold has been listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange since 1 November 2004, also under the code GLD, and is cross-listed in Botswana, Nigeria, Namibia, Mauritius and Ghana. Absa Capital listed it on the Ghana Stock Exchange on 22 August 2012, with 400,000 units; it was the first ETF on the exchange. More units have since been approved for the Ghana register: 3,400,000 in total after a June 2025 addition. IC Securities (Ghana) is its in-country sponsor. The issuer reports in US dollars and South African rand, with a financial year ending 31 March. At 30 September 2026 it held US$2.53 billion of bullion against an equal debenture liability, so its own profit is small.
description_full.source: Written by us from the Absa NewGold ETF minimum disclosure document (31 December 2023: structure, manager, market maker, JSE listing date), GSE PR 257/2012 (Ghana listing), GSE PR 313/2022 and PR 241/2025 (additional Ghana units, issuer details, in-country sponsor), the NewGold Issuer (RF) Limited audited financial statements for the year to 31 March 2026 (auditor's report: gold, platinum and palladium bullion investments) and the unaudited statements for the period to 30 September 2026 (statement of financial position), as filed with the GSE and the Nigerian Exchange. Cross-listings: the issuer's filings on the Botswana Stock Exchange, the Stock Exchange of Mauritius and the Nigerian Exchange, and its NSX (Namibia) code NGNGLD in PR 313/2022
